vibe_rationale: Melbourne's longest-running night market with real food culture, but a broad tourist and local crowd rather than a curated scene.
fit_notes: Weekly, high-footfall summer and winter market with a broad crowd, weak subculture depth and a general contact address. Good for sampling or a hospitality or workshop slot, and food-category partners such as Australian Dairy show brands can take a visible role. Weak as a headline partnership.
